Common misunderstanding.

Angels (malachim) are beings from Semitic mythology who are inferior to the gods. Some ancient Jewish and Christian Platonists admitted that they are equivalent to the sublunary beings from Greek mythology called daemones.

The Greek Jews who translated the Septuagint into Greek chose to translate the word for gods of the gentiles as "daemon" and thereby demote the gods to a sublunar status. But this was wrong. In Greek myth the daemones are completely different beings from the gods (theoi). Some Platonist philosophers theorised that no god would ever make itself physically apparent in this realm and that therefore apparitions or manifestations of the gods are actually daemones in the form of theoi, who are serving the theoi. This is much like the angels in the Bible who do the bidding of Yahweh. The angels manifest before people as messengers of the god of the Jews just as daemones manifest on behalf of their patron gods. Daemones have a relationship with matter and this realm that is different to that of gods. 

One Platonist answered the Christian critics who accused them of demon-worship by saying "yes" because demons (daemones) are emanations of the gods and so the daemons are a route to the highest and it is pious to worship them.

The equivalent of angels, that is beings superior to man, inferior to gods, in Germanic Heathenry are therefore beings who are associated with physical matter - Elves and dwarves. The angels are not gods and not all gods can "fall" because there have always been telluric as well as celestial deities.

Other entities that received funding via the same “active social engineering” contract in addition to Thomson Reuters include the Canadian version of GSA, Raytheon, the University of Southern California, government consultancies Mitre Corporation and SRI International, and HRL Laboratories, a joint venture of Boeing and General Motors.
